from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u086/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=programs/'task-a8b5b6d3.py'
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color == background:
                    continue
                pr, pc = r - dr, c - dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                run = [(r, c)]
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                while 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                    run.append((nr, nc))
                    nr, nc = nr + dr, nc + dc
                if len(run) < 2:
                    continue
                rr, cc = r - dr, c - dc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == background:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
                    rr, cc = rr - dr, cc - dc
                rr, cc = run[-1][0] + dr, run[-1][1] + dc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == background:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
                    rr, cc = rr + dr, cc + dc
    return out
'''
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(path), 'exec'))
print('saved', path)
